listIntro: Every item is split equally between everyone. If you want nothing from this list, untick yourself here; it covers things added later too. To skip a single item, use Skip on the receipt.
listOutNames: Not chipping in for the whole list: {names}.
listOutCount: {count, plural, one {# person isn't chipping in for the whole list.} other {# people aren't chipping in for the whole list.}}
listOutHint: You're not chipping in for the whole list.
optedOutCount: {count, plural, one {# person skips it} other {# people skip it}}
yourShare: Your share comes to about {amount} so far.
yourShareNone: You're not paying for anything on this list so far.
orphaned: Nobody wants this, so everyone chips in for it.
expenseCreated: A {amount} expense was added to Finance, split by who chips in for what.
expenseUpdated: The expense in Finance was recalculated: {amount}.
expenseSkippedEmpty: Nothing on the list has a price, so no expense was added to Finance.
expenseSkippedNoBanker: The chata has no banker, so no expense was added to Finance.
expenseFailed: The list is closed, but the expense didn't make it into Finance. Reopen it and close it again.
expenseRemoved: Nothing with a price is left on the list, so the expense was removed from Finance.
